reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for detecting, attributing, recording, and recovering from plugin failures through static inspection, crash reporting, local disabling, and safe-mode recovery.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的插件故障防护工具，可检查插件结构、显示崩溃归因、记录本地遥测并提供禁用和安全模式恢复功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin failure-protection tool that inspects plugin structure, attributes crashes, records local telemetry, and supports disabling and safe-mode recovery.

capabilities: Detects plugin contract and runtime failures
Displays crash attribution and recovery controls
Records local crash telemetry in JSONL files
Writes local patch configuration to disable plugins
Supports cross-profile inspection and next-boot disabling
